Temporary plan (please follow these steps so the calendar entry is correct for your team):
1) Use this Zoom fallback for the scheduled demo: https://zoom.us/j/9876543210?pwd=quickfallback (passcode: RedwoodDemo)
2) I attached a fresh invitation (invitation-fixed.ics) that is saved as plain UTF-8; please download and import if you prefer the calendar event to contain the URL.
3) If you already have a broken event in your calendar, please delete that entry before accepting the new one to avoid duplicates.

Ben — when you have a second, can you confirm join permissions (we should make the meeting SSO-disabled so FinoSys attendees can join without token failures)? Also can you plan to share the short latency/cost slide (first 8 slides) so Elena's team can review before we dig into infra details.

Elena/Andrew — happy to move the meeting to an alternate provider (Meet/Teams) if Zoom is blocked — please confirm.

Thanks,
Rafael
